address: 298 SE Winchester Hill Drive, Chehalis, WA 98532
description: Perched on a hilltop above downtown Chehalis, this inviting home captures territorial views from the front and a beautiful mountain backdrop from the backyard. Tucked away on a cul-de-sac, it feels removed while town is just minutes away.    Hardwood floors throughout the main level add warmth, while the kitchen takes center stage with custom soft-close cabinetry, Fisher & Paykel gas range with double ovens, full-size refrigerator and freezer, microwave drawer, beverage cooler and pot filler. The eat-up bar, pendant lighting and full-height custom backsplash with intricate tilework behind the range add style and function. The sink overlooks the backyard and mountain views. The kitchen flows into the dining and family rooms, with a separate living room, half bath and laundry completing the main level. Upstairs has all new carpet and offers a generous primary suite with ample closet space, two additional bedrooms, full bath and a versatile bonus room ideal for an office, media room or fourth bedroom.
